name: Amami Akira
source:
Akira is a daughter of the bloodline that is technically ruling over Amahara. Even so, she really doesn’t look as important as she should be. Goes over to Chihiro’s from time to time after changing her clothes and looks. She’s very energetic and loves erotic stuff. But when she goes to serious mode, her attitude takes a 180 degrees change and she turns into Amami Akira, the princess.
